reason: The plugin searches the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem, reviews candidate repositories and package information, and provides evidence-backed adoption recommendations without installing plugins or building new ones.

summaries.zh: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness 生态中的相关仓库，检查其说明和元数据，并根据证据给出是否值得尝试的建议。
summaries.en: Searches the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem, reviews relevant repository documentation and metadata, and provides evidence-based recommendations on which options are worth trying.

capabilities: Lists DeepSeek Harness packages and installed official packages
Reads repository README files, package manifests, and file trees
Produces evidence-based TRY, WATCH, or SKIP recommendations
